name: Foundation: Model Upgrade + Free-Tier Exploitation
goal: Upgrade to Gemini 3.5 (Flash default, Pro for deep analysis), enable structured JSON output, and exploit free-tier Deep Research. Immediate quality and speed improvement with zero infrastructure changes.

name: Web-Native: Built-in AI + WebMCP
goal: Make AIGestion web-native: zero-cost on-device AI for demos, WebMCP for browser agent discovery, DevTools for agent debugging, and HTML-in-Canvas for immersive UI. The landing page becomes a free, instant, offline-capable demo.

name: Agent Infrastructure: Managed Agents + Workspace
goal: Move DanielaOS agents to cloud-hosted Managed Agents with persistent environments. Connect 5 agents to real Google Workspace APIs. Define all 9 agents as markdown templates. Eliminate simulated actions and local execution limitations.

name: Autonomous Coding: Jules + Antigravity Orchestration
goal: Integrate Jules for real autonomous PR generation. Replace swarm dispatcher with Antigravity multi-agent orchestration. Enable scheduled agent tasks. The system writes, tests, and deploys real code autonomously.

name: Full Autonomy: Cloud Hosting + Browser Control + Fusion
goal: Full autonomous system: Firebase backend, Antigravity SDK cloud hosting, Auto Browse browser control, Android app generation, voice mode, and all fusion pipelines. DanielaOS becomes a 24/7 autonomous cloud operating system.
